findings.explanation: The supplied country document (IPC 2018 official report) establishes Fischbach's affiliation as a member of the 2018 U.S. Men's National Wheelchair Basketball Team. However, this document dates to January 2018. The case year is 2015 (violation date August 22, 2015 per case document line 8). An official team roster establishes sporting affiliation only for its stated period. The 2018 roster cannot demonstrate USA sporting affiliation for 2015 without independent evidence from that period. The proposed temporalNote explicitly warns against this inference ('本案事件為2015年，不據此推定2015年代表資格').
findings.suggestion: Provide dated official evidence from 2015 or earlier—such as 2015 ParaPan Am Games roster (referenced at case document line 97), 2015 national team selection records, or official IWBF competition results from that year—to establish USA sporting affiliation for the case period.
